configurePresets.name: vs2022
configurePresets.description: Same generator/architecture every agent already invokes directly (cmake -S . -B build_verify_X -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A x64) - this preset does not replace that direct invocation, it just gives it a name. binaryDir uses ${sourceDir} so each git worktree gets its own build directory automatically; concurrent agents in different worktrees never collide on one build tree.

configurePresets.name: ninja-release
configurePresets.displayName: Ninja Release (adds a faster single-config generator alongside VS)
configurePresets.description: New in this B1 build-infra task: Ninja is not a replacement for the Visual Studio generator every agent already depends on (that path is untouched - see the vs2022 preset above) - it's an additional, faster option for a plain `cmake --build` loop, especially paired with sccache (see CMakeLists.txt's own sccache section). Single-config, so Release/Debug are separate presets rather than a --config switch at build time.

configurePresets.name: ninja-debug
configurePresets.description: Same as ninja-release but CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug, own binaryDir so switching configs never invalidates the other's build tree.

configurePresets.name: verify
configurePresets.description: This task's own canonicalization (2026-10-07): same generator/binaryDir-per-worktree shape as the vs2022 preset above, but with CRREISH_VERIFY_BUILD=ON, so every real_*_test FAILS outright (instead of ctest-SKIPping, exit 77) if CRREISH_GAME_CACHE_DIR is absent at test time - see CMakeLists.txt's own CRREISH_VERIFY_BUILD comment block for the full reasoning. CRREISH_GAME_CACHE_DIR itself is NOT set here: its CACHE PATH default in CMakeLists.txt already points at this machine's real install, and a verify run should fail loudly (not silently fall back to some other path) if that default is ever wrong - pass -DCRREISH_GAME_CACHE_DIR=... explicitly to override it for a different machine. Own binaryDir so a verify configure never invalidates/is invalidated by a plain dev build in the same worktree.
